$comment: Single source of truth for product identity. The app, emails, certificates and docs read from here, so a future rename is a one-file change. See docs/architecture/adr/0001-separate-product-under-practicode-brand.md.

product.name: PractiCode Learn
product.headline: Learn code, data, design and AI by actually doing it.
product.promise: Learn the skills employers are hiring for.

parent.name: PractiCode Academy
parent.relationship: PractiCode Academy is the first delivery partner and runs the Mentor plan (cohorts, online and in Ibadan).

colorRules: Practi Yellow is a fill colour only. Never yellow text, thin yellow lines or glows.
Text on yellow is always Code Black or Ink.
In the product (Prism theme), yellow lives in the logo. Primary buttons are white unless the yellow option is chosen, and yellow buttons are always flat with no shadow.

theme.$comment: Prism, the chosen product theme (3 October 2026). See docs/design/design-system.md.
theme.name: Prism

light.$comment: Prism light mode. Same layout and components, different tokens. Chosen in Settings, Appearance: Dark, Light or Match device (default).
light.selectedState: Track tint at 14% opacity, a track-coloured border and dark text

rules: Colour means track. Never cycle track colours for decoration.
The AI tutor and site assistant use the brand gradient, never a track colour.
Copy never counts tracks or colours, so a new track is a data change.
Light and dark share every layout. Only tokens change.

display.note: Product headings in the Prism theme. The logo and wordmark stay in Poppins.

typography.case: Title Case for labels and buttons, sentence case for sentences. No all-caps except acronyms and literal code.

logo.productLockup: Yellow icon plus the Poppins wordmark (Practi Regular, Code Bold, Learn Regular) in white, on dark backgrounds. On light backgrounds: the black icon and a black wordmark.
logo.status: Interim redraws from the documented geometry. Replace with files from PractiCode_Academy_Official_Logo_Pack.zip.
